verdict.rationale: A public status page with uptime history and incident postmortems is a fair question for a hosted scraping API, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions a status page, uptime history or postmortems. The Usage API covers account credit and concurrency usage, not service uptime, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can check a public status page showing uptime history and past incident postmortems before committing to the service
